# Re[mark]able.net

> A blog by Mark Foppen on .NET, Azure, security, and developer experience for the agentic AI era. Practical, code-driven posts from a freelance full-stack developer and Azure Solutions Architect.

## Author

- Mark Foppen, freelance full-stack developer & Azure Solutions Architect
- Cre8-it: https://cre8-it.nl
- GitHub: https://github.com/foppenm
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/markfoppen
